name: summarization
description: Summarize one or more documents with configurable style and length

steps.description: Parse the document(s) into structured content
Generate a summary using the specified style (executive brief, detailed analysis, bullet points)
steps.note: Pass style instructions in the user message (e.g., "Summarize in 3 bullet points" or "Write an executive summary")

steps.description: For multi-document summarization, iterate over documents and combine
